questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed for the conditions. Stop at the marked line if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign means traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to slow down and allow merging traffic to safely join your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Prepare to allow those drivers to merge safely into traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from another road. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming curve to the right. Slow down and prepare for the turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The color orange is used only for construction and maintenance warning signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals always have red on top and green on the bottom when arranged vertically. When arranged horizontally, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roadways with a median or divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles carrying the minimum number of passengers shown on the sign may use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until it is clear and safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black and prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means you may use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells you that the right lane is ending. Be prepared for traffic merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you what you must do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings ahead. This yellow and black sign alerts you to be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. It may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that the road curves right first, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells you to watch for a side road crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.
